subject: Intro: Redwood + CedarBridge — AWS co-sell ask & proposed sprint
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cedarbridgehealth.com>, Mike Brennan <mike.brennan@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood + CedarBridge — AWS co-sell ask & proposed sprint

Hi Samantha / Mike —

Quick intro: I’m Jasmine (Solutions Lead at Redwood Inference). We’ve been working with the AWS field to identify a co-sell motion with CedarBridge Health after your architecture conversation last month. CedarBridge is exploring a hosted inference + private deployment path for regulated workloads; Redwood can support a hybrid approach with predictable latency and audit controls.

Wanted to propose a short joint sprint to align stakeholders and surface a small proof-of-value plan. High-level ask: 30–45m joint account planning + exec demo (internal + CedarBridge execs + AWS field).

Proposed outcomes:
- Shared success metrics and timelines (SLOs, cost targets)
- Technical owner mapping for an initial POC (data flow, network/KMS needs)
- Exec-level demo to secure budget commitment

Suggested dates (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2026-09-24 14:00–14:45
- Mon 2026-09-28 09:00–09:45

Attachments: CedarBridge_exec_brief_v1.pdf (1 page executive summary), Joint_Account_Playbook_draft.pptx (5 slides, proposed MA-plan template).

If you’re open, can you confirm who from CedarBridge should attend for exec + technical stakeholders, and which of the proposed slots works? I’ll follow up with a proposed agenda and calendar invite.

Thanks — look forward to connecting.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

Appreciate the intro and the clear outcomes. We’re interested in exploring this. For exec we’d want our Head of Digital Transformation (Daniel Park) and our CTO to join — I’ve looped Daniel below. For the technical pre-brief / POC owner, our SRE lead (Lydia Chen) will be the point of contact.

Of the slots you proposed, Thu 2026-09-24 14:00 PST works best for our execs. Can you share a brief agenda (20–30m exec demo + 15m technical Q&A), and any prerequisites (SSO details, data handling summary, compliance notes)?

Also — happy to have Mike from AWS join for the co-sell introduction.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz

Links / attachments:

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read.
